2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to assess whether kinase inhibition or angiogenesis pathways were modulated downstream of target engagement.

3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (OS) clearly failed - HR 1.01 (95% CI: 0.87-1.18), p=0.863, indicating no survival benefit. Secondary endpoints also failed: PFS showed only partial benefit (p=0.092) and ORR failed (p=0.427). The combination arm performed essentially identically to control.

4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported to identify differential responses.

5. CONFOUNDERS: Large adequately powered trial (N=823) with appropriate duration for OS endpoint. Some increased toxicity with sorafenib (thrombocytopenia 23.4% vs 8.8%) but not dose-limiting. No major trial design issues identified.
